review_notes: I read the whole file and searched the Formal Frontier tree and Mathlib's AlgebraicGeometry directory for competing concepts. Mathlib has no multiplicative group scheme, no Laurent-polynomial scheme and no units-of-global-sections classification of maps into Gₘ. The diagonal group scheme, its projections and the `Hom`-to-units equivalences therefore have no existing Mathlib counterpart. The file builds on Mathlib's `algΓAlgSpecAdjunction`, `hopfSpec`, `Fan`, `productIsProduct` and `isLimitOfReflects`, so it reuses the existing concepts. The deprecated aliases `diagonalAffineHomEquiv` and `diagonalAffineHomEquiv_comp` point to `affineSpecHomOverEquiv` and `affineSpecHomOverEquiv_comp`, so they are not independent competing definitions. `diagonalGroupSchemeFin0IsTerminal` is a small specialisation of `diagonalGroupSchemeEmptyIsTerminal`, which is a named specialisation and not substantive duplicated API. Remaining uncertainty: I did not exhaustively search Mathlib for every possible unit-valued hom-set equivalence. I did not open `AffineHomOver.lean` or `Multiplicative.lean`, so I did not check for duplication between this project's own files.
